{{merge|Team Skull trio}} {{CharInfobox |color={{black color light}} |corecolor={{dream color}} |bordercolor={{black color dark}} |name=Rapp |jname=ラップ |tmname=Wrap |slogan=no |image=Rapp.png |size=245px |caption=Rapp |region=[[Alola]] |gender=Female |colors=yes |eyes=Pink |hair=Pink |trainer=no |game=no |leader=no |team=yes |teamname=[[Team Skull]] |teamrank={{tc|Team Skull Grunt|Grunt}} |brain=no |anime=yes |epnum=SM001 |epname=Alola to New Adventure! |enva=[[Lori Phillips]] |java=[[Madoka Asahina]] }} '''Rapp''' (Japanese: '''ラップ''' ''Wrap'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is a member of [[Team Skull]], who often appears alongside [[Zipp]] and [[Tupp]]. ==History== ===''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]''=== Rapp debuted in ''[[SM001|Alola to New Adventure!]]'', where she, [[Zipp]], and [[Tupp]] challenged {{an|Kiawe}} to a {{pkmn|battle}} with his {{TP|Kiawe|Charizard}} on the line. Rapp and the other {{tc|Team Skull Grunt|Grunts}} took on his {{TP|Kiawe|Turtonator}} nine against one, until {{Ash}} came to assist Kiawe with his {{AP|Pikachu}}. After a short battle, Rapp and her partners were defeated by Turtonator's [[Z-Move]] {{m|Inferno Overdrive}}, forcing them to retreat. In ''[[SM011|Young Kiawe Had a Farm!]]'', Rapp and her teammates attacked Kiawe and Ash, seeking revenge for their previous defeat. However, the trio was quickly defeated by Pikachu's {{m|Gigavolt Havoc}}. In ''[[SM024|Alolan Open House!]]'', Rapp and her teammates visited the [[Pokémon School]], where they stole some [[Poké Ride|Ride]] {{p|Tauros}} and started wreaking havoc at the school. They were soon confronted by {{Delia}}, who took the Grunts on using [[Ash's Litten]]. When Ash and {{ashcl}} arrived, Team Skull was soon sent off again by Pikachu's Gigavolt Havoc. In ''[[SM025|A Team-on-Team Tussle!]]'', Rapp and her teammates encountered {{TRT}} for the first time. Both teams were after a [[Darkinium Z]] which Team Rocket managed to take. She took a shine when she saw a talking {{MTR}}, something that didn't impress her teammates. In ''[[SM027|A Glaring Rivalry!]]'', Rapp had a battle with {{an|Gladion}} but was quickly defeated by {{p|Lycanroc}}'s {{m|Stone Edge}}. In ''[[SM065|Turning Heads and Training Hard!]]'', Rapp assisted Tupp in getting revenge on [[Ilima]] alongside several other Team Skull Grunts. However, they were all defeated when Ilima's {{p|Eevee}} used {{m|Extreme Evoboost}}. In the process, Rapp and the other female Team Skull Grunts fell in love with Ilima. In ''[[SM068|Real Life...Inquire Within!]]'', Rapp and her teammates confronted Ash during an attempt to take {{AP|Poipole}}. They had a battle, which eventually ended when Zipp's {{p|Garbodor}}'s arm became blocked and released a horrible smell. In ''[[SM084|The Shape of Love to Come!]]'', Rapp and her teammates encountered [[Mina]], a wandering artist. Rapp, finding Mina's {{p|Ribombee}} to be cute, demanded that Mina hand it over to her. Mina accepted, but only if they could best her in a drawing competition. Though Mina liked the Team Skull Grunts' drawings enough that she wanted to call it a tie, Tupp decided to battle her after receiving criticism for his poor drawing. Rapp's Zubat was easily defeated by Ribombee's {{m|Pollen Puff}}. In ''[[SM099|We Know Where You're Going, Eevee!]]'', Rapp and Tupp fought over a wild [[Sandy|Eevee]] as the former wanted Eevee because she found it cute while the latter wanted to use it to make himself popular with girls. After being rescued by Ash's Pikachu, Eevee teamed up with [[Lana's Popplio]] to send the trio blasting off. In ''[[SM104|That's Some Spicy Island Research!]]'', Rapp and her teammates went to [[Poni Island]] under [[Plumeria]]'s orders. They had stolen radishes from [[Hapu]]'s field and were using them to lure and capture a number of {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Oricorio|Sensu Style}} {{p|Oricorio}} when they encountered Ash. They sent their Pokémon out to battle Ash, but were stopped when Hapu arrived. Hapu battled Team Skull using her {{p|Mudsdale}} and quickly defeated them. Plumeria showed up, unhappy with their efforts, and ordered them to follow her back. In ''[[SM115|The Dealer of Destruction!]]'', Rapp and his teammates arrived at the [[Shady House]] and told [[Guzma]] about {{an|Professor Kukui}}'s announcement of the [[Pokémon League]]. Rapp then accompanied Guzma, Plumeria, and her teammates to Melemele Island, briefly encountering Team Rocket before showing up at the Pokémon School to get Kukui's attention. In ''[[SM128|League Offenders and Defenders!]]'', Rapp and her teammates arrived at the [[Manalo Stadium]] to try and destroy the Pokémon League for Guzma's sake without telling him what they were doing. Their efforts were thwarted by Ash, Kiawe, and [[Hau]], who easily defeated their Pokémon. Afterwards, Guzma and Plumeria arrived and scolded the Grunts for their failure. In ''[[SM129|Battle Royal 151!]]'', Rapp competed in the [[Battle Royal]] preliminary round of the [[Manalo Conference]]. She and her teammates ganged up on Ilima and his Eevee, only to be defeated. In ''[[SM130|Battling Besties!]]'', Rapp watched Guzma battle Ilima alongside his fellow Team Skull Grunts and watched as her leader managed to defeat Ilima. In ''[[SM134|The Road to The Semifinals!]]'', Rapp and her teammates unsuccessfully attempted to intimidate {{an|Lana}} before her match against Guzma. Later, she cheered for Guzma during the battle. In ''[[SM135|The Final Four!]]'', Rapp and her teammates were spray-painting graffiti around Manalo Stadium when they were confronted by [[Mimo]]. Rapp and her teammates sent out their Pokémon to intimidate her, only to be stopped by Gladion and his {{TP|Gladion|Silvally}}. In ''[[SM136|Getting Down to The Ire!]]'' and ''[[SM137|The Wisdom Not to Run!]]'', Rapp cheered for Guzma during his battle against Ash and spoke to him following his loss. Though Guzma was ready to disband Team Skull, Rapp and the others were so fired up by the battle that they wanted stay by his side and learn to battle as well as he did. In ''[[SM146|Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!]]'', Rapp was briefly seen battling Guzma and his {{p|Golisopod}} for training. ===''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''=== In ''[[JN112|Helping the Hometown Hero!]]'', Rapp appeared along with Guzma, Plumeria, and his fellow Grunts watching the [[Battle Royal]] match between Ash, Kukui, {{an|Gladion}}, and {{an|Kiawe}}. ==Character== Rapp respects Tupp as her leader and agrees with everything he says. In ''[[SM025|A Team-on-Team Tussle!]]'', when {{TRT}} pointed out that Tupp left them behind to go after the Z-Crystal, Rapp completely misunderstood Tupp's intent to abandon them. Rapp takes a shine to Pokémon she considers cute, as shown in ''[[SM025|A Team-on-Team Tussle!]]'', where she took a liking to {{MTR}}. This was seen again in ''[[SM084|The Shape of Love to Come!]]'', where she fawned over Pokémon like {{p|Morelull}}, an {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Raichu}}, a {{p|Comfey}}, and Mina's Ribombee. This is seen again in ''[[SM099|We Know Where You're Going, Eevee!]]'', where she tried to catch an [[Sandy|Eevee]]. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} This listing is of Rapp's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: ===On hand=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Rapp |pkmn=Zubat (×3) |type1=Poison |type2=Flying |img=Rapp Zubat.png |epnum=SM001 |vajp=Yūji Ueda |vaen=Yūji Ueda |epname=Alola to New Adventure! |desc=Rapp's three {{p|Zubat}} are her only known Pokémon. They first appeared in ''[[SM001|Alola to New Adventure!]]'', where they took on [[Ash's Pikachu]] and [[Kiawe's Turtonator]], but were defeated by Turtonator's {{m|Inferno Overdrive}}. One of the Zubat later reappeared in ''[[SM011|Young Kiawe Had a Farm!]]''. It was soon defeated when Ash's Pikachu attacked [[Team Skull]] with {{m|Gigavolt Havoc}}. One of the Zubat appeared again in ''[[SM024|Alolan Open House!]]'', but was defeated once again by Pikachu's [[Z-Move]]. In ''[[SM025|A Team-on-Team Tussle!]]'', Rapp sent Zubat out to battle a {{pkmn2|Totem}} {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Raticate}}, but was quickly defeated. In ''[[SM065|Turning Heads and Training Hard!]]'', Zubat was used to battle [[Ilima]]'s {{p|Eevee}}, but was eventually defeated by Eevee's {{m|Last Resort}}, which was powered up by its use of {{m|Extreme Evoboost}}. In ''[[SM084|The Shape of Love to Come!]]'', Zubat was drawn by its Trainer as a part of a challenge from [[Mina]] to see whom could produce the best drawing of one of their Pokémon. When its Trainer and her fellow Team Skull members became angry, they attacked Mina. With the help of Ash, Mina defeated the Team Skull trio and sent them running away in fear. In ''[[SM099|We Know Where You're Going, Eevee!]]'', Zubat was relaxing on the beach, only to be {{m|Tackle}}d by an [[Sandy|Eevee]]. Zubat was then used to attack Ash and his classmates, only to be sent flying by Eevee's {{m|Double-Edge}}. In ''[[SM104|That's Some Spicy Island Research!]]'', Zubat was sent out to battle [[Hapu]] and her {{p|Mudsdale}}. Mudsdale withstood all of Salandit, Zubat, and Garbodor's attacks before quickly defeating them with {{m|High Horsepower}}. Zubat reappeared in ''[[SM128|League Offenders and Defenders!]]'' and ''[[SM129|Battle Royal 151!]]''. The Zubat's known moves are {{m|Leech Life}}, {{m|Venoshock}}, {{m|Bite}}, {{m|Toxic}}, {{m|Supersonic}}, {{m|Wing Attack}}, and {{m|Air Cutter}}{{tt|*|mentioned only}}.}} ===Ride Pokémon=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Rapp |pkmn=Tauros |gender=male |type1=Normal |img=Team Skull Ride Tauros.png |cap=A Poké Ride Tauros |epnum=SM024 |epname=Alolan Open House! |vajp= |vaen= |desc=Rapp briefly stole a {{p|Tauros}}, which she used to wreak havoc at the [[Pokémon School]] before being confronted by {{Delia}}. Once she was defeated, Rapp left Tauros behind.
